# Monotonic ULID generator behaviour. "reset" starts a new generator.
#   next <now_ms> <random_hex> <expected>
# random_hex: the 10 bytes the random source returns if the call draws randomness,
#             or "-" if the call must not draw any.
# expected:   the canonical ULID, or "error" (the call fails and the generator is unchanged).
